entries.text: You see Jasmine.

entries.text: Excuse me, sir, this person is a member of one of the merchant guilds.

entries.text: Let me get this straight; you're shooting my boss and my friends, and you want to talk? Get bent!
entries.source_text: Let me get this straight; you're shooting my boss and my friends, and you want to talk? Get bent!

entries.text: The door's over there. Don't let it hit you on the way out.

entries.text: Hi. Welcome to the Circle of Thieves. Play your cards right and you're in.
entries.source_text: Hi. Welcome to the Circle of Thieves. Play your cards right and you're in.

entries.text: Welcome to the Circle of Thieves. I'm Jasmine. I'm here to help make your infiltration of the Daren Hightower estate as painless as possible. Hightower's estate is located in the Heights. It has a minimum of two guards on duty at all times. The necklace is probably in a strongbox, which often have some minor traps, so be careful. Here are some lockpicks and a couple of flares to make your job a little easier.. And a bottle of Nuka-Cola.  Try not to kill Mr. Hightower.  He's one of our "favorite" people. You got all that?
entries.source_text:
Welcome to the Circle of Thieves. I'm Jasmine. I'm here to help make your infiltration of the 
Daren Hightower estate as painless as possible. Hightower's estate is located in the Heights. It has a 
minimum of two guards on duty at all times. The necklace is probably in a strongbox, which often have 
some minor traps, so be careful. Here are some lockpicks and a couple of flares to make your job a little 
easier.. And a bottle of Nuka-Cola.  Try not to kill Mr. Hightower.  He's one of our "favorite" people. You 
got all that?

entries.text: What do you mean by "favorite."
entries.source_text: What do you mean by "favorite."

entries.text: Lockpicks and Flares? That's all.
entries.source_text: Lockpicks and Flares? That's all.

entries.text: Nuka Cola?
entries.source_text: Nuka Cola?

entries.text: Don't kill him? No promises, woman.
entries.source_text: Don't kill him? No promises, woman.

entries.text: This job sucks. Find someone else.
entries.source_text: This job sucks. Find someone else.

entries.text: No problem. I'm outta here.
entries.source_text: No problem. I'm outta here.

entries.text: Runk!
entries.source_text: Runk!

entries.text: Excuse me, sir, but shouldn't you be working on your assignment?

entries.text: Well done, lad.  Here's your reward.  [Jasmine gives you 3000 bucks]

entries.text: Hello again.

entries.text: Well, he's been our benefactor on many occasions. If you kill him, someone smarter may take his place. We wouldn't like that.

entries.text: Pfah! A real thief lives on her wits. We're being generous with you. Now scat!

entries.text: They're our corporate sponsor. Loxley got thirsty, and they "donated" several dozen bottles to us. Real nice of them to help us out.

entries.text: Fine. I think I can speak for Mr. Loxley when I say that I hope we never cross paths again. Get out of here.
